svg.title: MedX — Deployment & Security Zones
svg.text: Reference implementation on an HDS-certified public cloud · multi-AZ primary region · warm-standby DR region · isolated accounts
Production account · VPC with public / application / data subnets in 3 availability zones
Load balancers — L7 (HTTPS / WSS) and L4 (media) · NAT gateways · TLS 1.3 only
Media nodes: SFU + TURN (A) · public UDP
Media nodes: SFU + TURN (B) · public UDP
Media nodes: SFU + TURN (C) · public UDP
API Gateway · Real-time Gateway · mesh ingress
Keycloak IdP · User Management · policy bundles (OPA)
Records · Emergency Access · Consultation · Scheduling · Prescription · Pharmacy · Document Store
Notification · Audit · data jobs | Payment namespace: Billing & Payment (strict network policy)
Warm standby · same blueprint (IaC) · EEA only
Serves critical summaries from local replicas
Tier 0: survives the loss of the primary region
IdP database replicated · signing keys shared
Clinicians can still sign in during a failover
All services deployed at minimum size
Same keys usable in both regions
Backup vault copy in a separate account
one cloud account per environment and purpose · separate keys · no network path from non-production to production data
